title: Not worth the price tag
text: Of course my 7 year old daughter is excited to receive something with unknown contents as a surprise but the contents were certainly not worth the subscription price.  I could purchase items at dollar tree or five below stores that were better quality and more items for under the price of this box. First box had 3 scrunchies, earrings, bath bomb and lip masks.  Second box had a small llama keychain, face cleaner brush, face mask soap, necklace and hair ties.  If the items were of better quality, it could be worth it.  It’s just not for us.
label: neutral
